stories.text: 😱 INSTANT REGRET: 49er Faith-Fool needs 4.78 pts more to beat Ramosverse. Starting Dalton Kincaid over Hunter Henry would have locked it up.
😱 INSTANT REGRET: TDsMaGee needs 6.72 pts more to beat Kirbo Crushers. Starting Kirk Cousins over Jayden Daniels would have locked it up.
👀 All eyes on Swift (CHI @ SEA): if Swift tops 4.78 pts, 49er Faith-Fool (82%) beats Ramosverse. ESPN projects 14.82 pts.
👀 All eyes on Wilson (CHI @ SEA): if Wilson tops 6.72 pts, TDsMaGee (52%) beats Kirbo Crushers. ESPN projects 6.99 pts.
⏳ Ruffing the Passer (91.3%) needs 12.62 pts more from Odunze, Myers and Barner (CHI @ SEA) to catch The Mahomies. ESPN projects 27.20 pts.
⏳ Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy (86%) needs 12.96 pts more from Loveland, D/ST and Santos (CHI @ SEA) to catch Gibb it to Me Baby. ESPN projects 26.17 pts.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: 49er Faith-Fool vs Ramosverse. Playoff odds with a win / loss: 49er Faith-Fool 74% / 46%, Ramosverse 20% / 5.5%.
🪓 DEATH WATCH: In My Fantasy Era (65% chop odds) needs 39.16 pts more from D/ST and Myers (CHI @ SEA) to pass Joe's Scary Team and survive.
🛒 WAIVER WIRE MVP: Ramosverse's pickups have put 266.82 pts into its starting lineup this season, led by Stroud (73.12 pts) and McLaughlin (66.00 pts).
🚮 POINTS ABANDONED: Players The Mahomies has cut in the last 3 weeks have scored 61.86 pts since, led by Brissett (26.86 pts) and Gesicki (25.20 pts).
🛒 HOT PICKUP: TDsMaGee grabbed Kirk Cousins (QB) off the wire on Sunday, and it's paying off — 28.18 pts this week (from the bench!).
🧠 Perfect lineup calls so far: Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy, Ramosverse and Ruffing the Passer haven't left a single point on the bench.
📈 Ruffing the Passer was down to 22% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
